chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Breaks Into Spirit-Treasury – Gains Rare Melting Weapon Ability in Storm
chapter_meta_description: Amid a supernatural storm, Xiao Chen's broken blade awakens, Keke reveals hidden artifacts, and Xiao Chen finally breaks into the Spirit-Treasury realm, unlocking the legendary Melting Weapon into Body ability.
og_description: Xiao Chen's broken blade guides him through a mystic sword dance as Heavenly Emperor City's ancient secrets emerge. A breakthrough that changes everything.
twitter_description: A terrifying storm unveils ghostly warriors and sacred artifacts. Xiao Chen's first divine ability—Melting Weapon into Body—marks his full entry into the Spirit-Treasury realm.
